items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: Was that one of Dr. Bechet's sons?

ctx.x: Sidney Bechet's nephew and I used to go to school together. We used to take up music together. He had a nephew who played banjo and guitar.
Which one is that? Was that one of Dr. Bechet's sons?
I don't know if it was the doctor but he was from back in Great Town. No.
